column3: Concerning the 1601 Brown Road Mortgaged Property, having an allocated loan amount of $28,981,399 or 1.8% of the related Whole Loan amount, an REC was identified in connection with a 20,000-gallon diesel fuel UST used for fleet fueling. The UST is 19 years old and no compliance testing documentation exists. No releases are reported. The environmental consultant provided an upper range estimate within a statistical 90% confidence interval that costs to address additional investigation and remediation would not exceed $490,000.
